PAC-MAN v1.5 — Ghosts! More ghosts!

LAUNCH
  ./run.sh
  (or: python3 pac-man.py config.json — needs Python 3.10+)

MENU
  Arrows/WASD ......... navigate / move (Cyrillic layout works too)
  Enter/Space ......... confirm
  Esc ................. back

GAME
  Arrows/WASD ......... move (4 directions, no diagonals)
  P or Esc ............ pause (P resumes, Esc abandons to menu)

CHEATS (reviewer shortcuts)
  1 ................... master switch (required first; marks the
                        run — cheated scores are never saved)
  2 ................... invincibility (ghosts can't catch you)
  3 ................... double speed
  4 ................... skip level
  5 ................... clear level (eat all dots, honest win)
  6 ................... fright now (edible ghosts)
  7 ................... lose a life (reach Game Over fast)
  8 ................... freeze ghosts (they hold position)
  9 ................... extra life (+1 life)

FUN
  T ................... cycle color theme (10 total)
  G ................... ghost party (color shuffle + disco walls)

HIGHSCORES
  Top 10 with names, stored in highscores.json next to the game.
  Names: ASCII letters/digits/spaces, max 10 chars.
  After win or game over, type a name + Enter to save (Esc skips).

CONFIG
  config.json — lives, pacgum count, points, seed, level sizes,
  time limit, highscore file. Bad values are clamped with a
  warning; the game never crashes on a bad config.
